name: Fixed Text Link Formatter
description: Formats a link field with a configurable fixed link text.
project_description:
The Fixed text link formatter module allows links and files to be formatted with a fixed link text.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires no additional contrib modules.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. See:

 https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/extending-drupal-8/installing-contributed… 

for further information.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 The module has no menu or modifiable settings. Configuration is done on a field by field

basis on the Manage display page by selecting the *Link with text field* formatter.

 For usability it is recommended to disable the input of a custom link text.
